text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. I'll be able to run 
again in no time.
choice_data_list: Make sure you rest up today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer... Could I go for a short run 
once I've rested...?
choice_data_list:
If it gets worse, you'll be even less able 
to run.

Let's get you patched up soon so you can 
run lots!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. Please keep an eye on me 
so that I don't run."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not, um... very confident, so...

That day, I stayed in the infirmary 
watching over Silence Suzuka until 
nightfall.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I really can't run today, can I? 
Even though it's still so bright out—

Silence Suzuka was feeling down for a 
while after being unable to run due to her 
injury.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll get better right away. 
Right away. If it means I can run...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please look for a wonderful place 
where I can run to my heart's content, 
okay?

Despite her injury, Silence Suzuka seemed 
full of drive. I should look for a new 
running course for her.
